author: Ezreal98
quote: This remake is a trip down memory lane; it brings back the game that revolutionized the industry 28 years ago—a title still used as a benchmark today. While some might find it simple or easy, the game makes no pretense of offering mechanics different from the original. As the name suggests, it is a remake: the very game that truly revolutionized the industry, now presented with modern graphics. It is a title well worth playing to discover the origins of today’s gaming landscape.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: Ezreal98
quote: Despite the graphics and the realism they aimed to incorporate, the game itself offers no revolutionary mechanics; it runs at 30 fps, has been plagued by bugs since its release, and brings nothing new to the table other than serving as a real-life simulator.
